string.name: account
string.comment: The account screen title.

string.name: accountPreferences
string.comment: Displayed on settings screen. This is for preferences synced with website on the server.

string.name: accountPreferencesHelp
string.comment: Help displayed on the account preferences screen.

resources.string: ಈ ಆದ್ಯತೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಲೈಚೆಸ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಾಧನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

string.name: allGames
string.comment: This is shown instead of 'Number of Games' if the number could not be loaded

string.name: areYouSure
string.comment: This is shown in confirmation dialogs.

string.name: boardSettings
string.comment: This is shown in the app main settings screen, which opens a screen dedicated to chess board settings.

string.name: cancelTakebackOffer
string.comment: Menu action that cancels a previous takeback offer

string.name: clearButton
string.comment: Buttons that clear things, e.g. recent searches. Should be short.

string.name: correspondenceClearSavedMove
string.comment: This is shown in the correspondence game screen. Will clear the saved move.

string.name: customGameJoinAGame
string.comment: This is shown in the custom game screen. Will open the game lobby.

string.name: feedbackButton
string.comment: Shown in the settings, pressing this button will redirect to the lichess contact site.

string.name: goodEvening
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, e.g. 'Good evening, GM Magnus' (%s is substituted with the user's name). This is associated with a 'moon' icon and is displayed only between 18:00 and 06:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

string.name: goodEveningWithoutName
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, when the user is not logged in. This is associated with a 'moon' icon and is displayed only between 18:00 and 06:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

string.name: goodDay
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, e.g. 'Good day, GM Magnus' (%s is substituted with the user's name). This is associated with a 'sun' icon and is displayed only between 06:00 and 18:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

string.name: goodDayWithoutName
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, when the user is not logged in. This is associated with a 'sun' icon and is displayed only between 06:00 and 18:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

string.name: hideVariation
string.comment: Shown in the analysis screen.

string.name: homeTab
string.comment: The tab in bottom navigation bar. Must be very short (10 characters max) to avoid ugly text shifting issues.

string.name: liveStreamers
string.comment: This is shown as a heading in the streamer screen

string.name: mustBeLoggedIn
string.comment: This is shown when the user tries to access a feature that requires login.

resources.string: ಈ ಪುಟ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಲು ನೀವು ಲಾಗ್ ಇನ್ ಆಗಿರಬೇಕು.

string.name: nbOfflinePuzzles
string.comment: Label for the puzzle setting that controls how many puzzles are downloaded and kept available for offline play.

string.name: newGame
string.comment: New game button in OTB and play against offline computer features

string.name: noSearchResults
string.comment: This is shown when the search did not return any results.

string.name: notAllFeaturesAreAvailable
string.comment: This is shown in the welcome message when the app is first installed

resources.string: ಹಳೆಯ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಅಥವಾ ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಲಭ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಗಮನಿಸಿ, ಆದರೆ ನಾವು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲೂ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇವೆ.

string.name: notFollowingAnyUser
string.comment: This is shown in the list that contains user followed by the user. Displayed if the user does not follow any users.

string.name: okButton
string.comment: This is used in varius confirmations dialogs. Translation should be short.

string.name: overTheBoard
string.comment: Used in the main play menu to launch the Over the board game mode.

string.name: playersMatchingSearchTerm
string.comment: This is shown when searching for a player. %s is the string that user entered in the search bar

string.name: positionLeft
string.comment: Appears in the board settings screen to indicate clock position.

string.name: positionRight
string.comment: Appears in the board settings screen to indicate clock position.

string.name: prefMagnifyDraggedPiece
string.comment: Title of a setting the settings screen. When enabled, the piece being dragged around the board will be magnified.

string.name: puzzleStormConfirmEndRun
string.comment: Text of the confirmation dialog when ending a puzzle storm run

string.name: puzzleStormFilterNothingToShow
string.comment: Shown when the user has no puzzles matching the filter criteria

resources.string: ತೋರಿಸಲು ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿ

string.name: puzzleStormNothingToShow
string.comment: Shown when the user has not played any puzzle storm runs yet. Prefer to not translate Puzzle Storm.

resources.string: ತೋರಿಸಲು ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಪಜಲ್ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಮ್ ನ ಕೆಲವು ರನ್ ಗಳನ್ನು ಆಡಿ.

string.name: puzzleStormSubtitle
string.comment: Shown as a description for the 'Puzzle Storm' mode

string.name: puzzleStreakAbortWarning
string.comment: Shown as a subtitle in the confirmation dialog for aborting puzzle streak. Prefer to not translate Puzzle Streak

resources.string: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಕ್ ಅನ್ನು ನೀವು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀರಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ಕೋರ್ ಉಳಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ.

string.name: puzzleThemesSubtitle
string.comment: Shown as a description for the 'Puzzle themes' mode

resources.string: ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ತೆರೆಯುವಿಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ಒಗಟುಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ಲೇ ಮಾಡಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಥೀಮ್ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

string.name: puzzlesTab
string.comment: The tab in bottom navigation bar. Must be very short (10 characters max) to avoid ugly text shifting issues.

string.name: recentSearches
string.comment: Title of the recent searches section in the search screen.

string.name: removeBookmark
string.comment: Label of the action of removing a game bookmark. Used in various places of the app where the space in constrained so this should remain short (eg: don't translate as 'Remove game bookmark', keep the essential).

string.name: serverAnalysis
string.comment: Title of a switch in analysis settings, used to toggle the server analysis display.

string.name: settingsClockPosition
string.comment: Clock position entry in main settings screen.

string.name: settingsCustomBackgroundPresets
string.comment: Displayed on the custom background theme screen.

string.name: settingsDraggedPieceTarget
string.comment: Dragged piece target entry in main settings screen.

string.name: settingsDraggedTargetCircle
string.comment: Dragged target settings circle type. One of the possible values of 'Dragged piece target' settings.

string.name: settingsDraggedTargetSquare
string.comment: Dragged target settings square type. One of the possible values of 'Dragged piece target' settings.

string.name: settingsHomeWidgets
string.comment: Settings entry. Allow to enable which widgets are displayed on the home screen.

string.name: settingsImmersiveMode
string.comment: Entry in the settings. When enabled, the app will hide the navigation bar and status bar.

string.name: settingsImmersiveModeSubtitle
string.comment: Subtitle for the 'Immersive Mode' setting. Gives an explanation of what the button does.

resources.string: ಆಟವಾಡುವಾಗ ಸಿಸ್ಟಂ UI ಅನ್ನು ಮರೆಮಾಡಿ. ಪರದೆಯ ಅಂಚುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಸ್ಟಂನ ನ್ಯಾವಿಗೇಷನ್ ಸನ್ನೆಗಳಿಂದ ನಿಮಗೆ ತೊಂದರೆಯಾದರೆ ಇದನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ. ಆಟ ಮತ್ತು ಪಜಲ್ ಪರದೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

string.name: settingsMaterialDifferenceCapturedPieces
string.comment: A value of the material difference settings choice (to show all captured pieces instead of material difference).

string.name: settingsPickAnImage
string.comment: Displayed in theme background choice screen, to allow user to pick and image from the image library as app custom background.

string.name: settingsPickAnImageHelp
string.comment: Displayed in theme background choice screen, to help user pick an image.

resources.string: ಕಸ್ಟಮ್ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆ ಡಾರ್ಕ್ ಮೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಡಾರ್ಕ್ ಚಿತ್ರವನ್ನು ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.

string.name: settingsPickAnImageBlur
string.comment: Displayed in theme background choice screen, to blur the chosen image.

string.name: settingsPickAnImageHideBoard
string.comment: Displayed in theme background choice screen, to hide the board when viewing chosen image.

string.name: settingsPickAnImageShowBoard
string.comment: Displayed in theme background choice screen, to show the board when viewing chosen image.

string.name: settingsPickAnImageSwipeToDisplay
string.comment: Displayed in theme background choice screen, when viewing colors presets to display other colors backgrounds.

string.name: settingsPieceShiftMethodEither
string.comment: A value of piece shift method settings entry.

string.name: settingsPieceShiftMethodTapTwoSquares
string.comment: A value of piece shift method settings entry.

string.name: settingsShapeDrawing
string.comment: Entry in the settings.

string.name: settingsShapeDrawingSubtitle
string.comment: Help message for the 'Shape drawing' settings entry.

resources.string: ಎರಡು ಬೆರಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಆಕಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ: ಒಂದು ಬೆರಳನ್ನು ಖಾಲಿ ಚೌಕದ ಮೇಲೆ ಇರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯಲು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಬೆರಳನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ.

string.name: settingsShowBorder
string.comment: Settings found in theme screen. If enabled a border will be shown around the board.

string.name: settingsTouchFeedback
string.comment: Entry in the settings. When enabled, the app will vibrate on some game events like move and capture.

string.name: settingsTouchFeedbackSubtitle
string.comment: Help message for the touch feedback settings entry in main settings screen.

resources.string: ಸಕ್ರಿಯಗೊಳಿಸಿದಾಗ, ನೀವು ಒಂದು ತುಣುಕನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ಸೆರೆಹಿಡಿಯುವಾಗ ಸಾಧನವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಮಯದ ನಂತರ ಕಂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

string.name: settingsTab
string.comment: The tab in bottom navigation bar. Must be very short (10 characters max) to avoid ugly text shifting issues.

string.name: shareGamePGN
string.comment: Menu action that shares the PGN of a game

string.name: shareGameURL
string.comment: Menu action that shares the URL of the current game

string.name: sharePositionAsFEN
string.comment: Menu action that shares the current position as a FEN string

string.name: sharePuzzle
string.comment: This is shown in the puzzle screen. When pressed, the user can share the puzzle.

string.name: showComments
string.comment: Shown in the analysis screen.

string.name: showResult
string.comment: This is the label of a button in the bottom bar shown when viewing a game from your history. Pressing the button will open a dialog showing the game's result (e.g 'White resigned') and displaying button such as 'new opponent'

string.name: showVariations
string.comment: Shown in the analysis screen.

string.name: somethingWentWrong
string.comment: This is a generic text to be shown when something unexpected happens, e.g. failing to load data from the server.

string.name: systemColors
string.comment: The title of the system colors setting. When enabling this, tha app's colors will match those of the operating system.

string.name: theme
string.comment: Graphic theme section in the global app settings.

string.name: toolsTab
string.comment: The tab in bottom navigation bar. Must be very short (10 characters max) to avoid ugly text shifting issues. Currently this includes the analysis board, the chess clock, and importing a position by PGN/FEN

string.name: unsupportedVariant
string.comment: Shown when trying to access/play a variant not yet supported in the app.

resources.string: ಈ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಟದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ %s ದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡಲು ಸಧ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

string.name: waitingForOpponentToJoin
string.comment: This is after the user has created a game and is waiting for an opponent to join.

string.name: watchTab
string.comment: The tab in bottom navigation bar. Must be very short (10 characters max) to avoid ugly text shifting issues.

string.name: welcomeToLichessApp
string.comment: A welcome message shown only the first time the app is installed.

string.name: viewGame
string.comment: Button text in puzzle settings to view the originating game.

string.name: customizeHomeTip
string.comment: Shown in a widget on the home screen to let the user know that they can customize their homescreen

resources.string: ಸಲಹೆ: ನೀವು ಮುಖಪುಟ ಪರದೆಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ವಿಜೆಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ನಿಮಗೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲದವುಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಬಹುದು!

string.name: customizeHomeTipDismiss
string.comment: Hides the widget to customize the home screen.

string.name: customizeButton
string.comment: Text of a button, so translation should be short.

string.name: stopShowingThreat
string.comment: This disables the 'Show Treat' mode in analysis.

string.name: tournamentCompleted
string.comment: Title of a tab in the tournament screen, showing tournaments that are already completed. Translation should be short ideally one word

string.name: tournamentJumpToMyPage
string.comment: Accessibility description of a button that jumps to user's position in tournament standings

string.name: challengeCreated
string.comment: Shown as a bottom banner when another player has been challenged.

resources.string: ಸವಾಲು ರಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ: ಆಟ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾದಾಗ ನಿಮಗೆ ಸೂಚಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. \n ನೀವು ಅದನ್ನು ಹೋಮ್ ಟ್ಯಾಬ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಬಹುದು.

string.name: previousPage
string.comment: Shows the previous page, e.g. in tournament standings

string.name: orImportPgnFile
string.comment: Button text to import a PGN file from the device

resources.string: ಅಥವಾ PGN ಫೈಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಆಮದು ಮಾಡಿ

string.name: goodMoveButThereIsBetter
string.comment: Verdict shown in the offline computer game when the player's move is good but not the best move available.
